name: run_ledger_short_partial_close
description: Short-side sign convention: two sells build a short average entry, then a partial buy closes part of it. realized = (exec - entry)*closed_qty*mult*sign(position) must come out positive when the short is covered lower.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. FILL -4 @100 fee=0: entry=100, mark=100, qty=-4, wallet 1000, u=0. FILL -2 @115 fee=0: increasing the short, entry=(4*100+2*115)/(4+2)=(400+230)/6=630/6=105; mark=115; qty=-6; u=-6*1*(115-105)=-60; equity=1000-60=940. FILL +3 @90 fee=0: reducing, closed_qty=3, sign(position)=-1; realized=(90-105)*3*1*(-1)=(-15)*(-3)=+45; wallet=1000+45=1045; entry stays 105; qty=-3; mark=90; u=-3*1*(90-105)=-3*(-15)=+45; equity=1045+45=1090. Sanity: covering 3 of a 105 short at 90 earns (105-90)*3=45. Final: wallet 1045, unrealized 45, equity 1090, realized 45, fees 0, funding 0, position -3. Per-event equity processing order: [1000, 940, 1090].
